productConcept.name: Volt Studio
productConcept.description: A browser-native 3D web experience builder for interaction designers who want dimensional, physics-driven interfaces without writing WebGL.
productConcept.rationale: The Still Voltage design system's dark near-black palette (#19191c), pink-red accent (#fd356e), kinetic easing (Material Standard cubic-bezier), generous pill CTAs, and concept drawn from bruno-simon's dimensional depth and ambient persistence mapped directly to a creative tooling product — specifically a 3D scene builder where the UI itself demonstrates the product's capabilities.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion system has non-trivial stagger choreography (step: 0.1s, indices 0–6), named Material Standard easing curve, and concept_by_video.md describes ambient persistence and scroll-driven kinetic motion.
generationMethod: pipeline.js concurrency=5 (first pass: 12/22), recover-from-history.js (3/10 recovered), pipeline.js concurrency=2 (final 7/7)
